title: Enterprise SSO & OAuth2 Configuration Guide
content: Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. For Azure AD integration, configure the reply URL to https://auth.enterprise.io/login/callback. If error ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED (Code 4012) occurs, verify that clock skew tolerance is set to >= 300 seconds and token refresh interval is enabled under Security Settings.

title: Database Connection Pooling & Failover Architecture
content: The database connection pool maintains min=10 and max=100 connections. When connection timeouts (ERR_CONN_TIMEOUT / Code 5003) exceed 5 seconds under peak traffic, check the Max Idle Connections parameter and enable read-replica load balancing.

title: API Gateway Rate Limiting & Throttling Policies
content: API Gateway applies a sliding-window rate limit of 1,000 requests/minute per API key. Rate limit breach returns HTTP 429 (ERR_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Premium tier customers can request quota increases up to 10,000 req/min via customer configuration settings.
